Operation Wolf.name: Operation Wolf
Operation Wolf.summary: A port of the arcade game that supports the Zapper and the Light Phaser, for the Nintendo Entertainment System and Sega Master System respectively. All the voice acting has been removed and the targets are much smaller due to sprite limitations.

Ultima IV - Quest of the Avatar.name: Ultima IV
Ultima IV - Quest of the Avatar.summary: A Sega Master System port of Ultima IV: Quest of the Avatar.
